title: PP packing gain vs gate/lattice orientation (does the dM=0 magic angle break the ~1.4x cap?)
acceptance_criterion: Confirmatory hypothesis test. Hypothesis: a non-parallel / tilted-quantization-axis gate geometry placing the binding diagonal neighbor at the dM=0 magic angle (54.7 deg) removes the diagonal-neighbor constraint and pushes the 2D packing gain above the ~1.3-1.4x cap. Predictions: (1) the dM=0 magic angle does NOT zero the total C6 - the (1-3cos^2 theta)^2 channel vanishes there but the sin^4 theta channel remains, so |C6(54.7 deg)| = c2*(4/9) ~ 120 GHz*um^6 >> 0; (2) the genuine total-C6 zero is at a different angle theta* ~ 22.9 deg (repulsive dM=0 cancels attractive dM=+-2); (3) the maximum 2D packing gain over orientation at n=60 does not exceed 1.6x. Verdict reads computed.max_gain_over_orientation, computed.c6_at_dm0_magic_angle_ghz_um6, computed.c6_total_zero_angle_deg. CONFIRMED iff (max gain <= 1.6x) AND (|C6(54.7 deg)| > 10 GHz*um^6); REFUTED (ceiling geometry-specific, directive reopens) iff (max gain > 1.6x) OR (|C6(54.7 deg)| < 1 GHz*um^6).
verdict_note: Mechanical application of the frozen criterion: computed.max_gain_over_orientation = 1.956 > 1.6, which triggers the REFUTED branch (the ~1.4x cap is NOT a robust ceiling within the C6 model). Independently, prediction (1) is CONFIRMED: |C6(54.7 deg)| = 120.3 >> 10 GHz*um^6, so the dM=0 magic angle does NOT zero the interaction and cannot be the mechanism that removes the diagonal constraint. CRITICAL CAVEAT: the >1.6x orientations (theta_gate ~ 24-30 deg) sit near the genuine total-C6 zero at 22.9 deg, where the two-channel model's leading term vanishes and the gain DIVERGES as theta_gate -> 22.9 deg (gate length -> 0). This is a model breakdown, not a physical packing win: (a) the C6 zero is an unverified interpolation (E1 anchored only theta=0,90), (b) near the zero the higher-order (C8) interaction dominates so the physical interaction does not vanish, (c) the gate is a weak-blockade configuration (C6(26 deg)=4.7 vs C6(90 deg)=268 GHz*um^6). For a physical strong-blockade gate (theta_gate=90 deg) the gain stays ~1.33-1.40x.

premise_corrections.premise: The dM=0 magic angle (54.7 deg, where (1-3cos^2 theta)^2 vanishes) can remove the diagonal-neighbor constraint and break the ~1.4x packing cap
premise_corrections.corrected: The dM=0 magic angle zeroes ONLY the (1-3cos^2 theta)^2 channel; the total C6 at 54.7 deg is +120.30 GHz*um^6 (the sin^4 theta dM=+-2 channel remains at 4/9 of its max), which is LARGER than C6(0)=-10.41 and C6(30)=12.85. It cannot remove the interaction. The genuine total-C6 zero is at 22.909 deg, where the repulsive dM=0 and attractive dM=+-2 channels cancel.
premise_corrections.consequence: The E2 FollowUp's stated mechanism (54.7 deg) is physically incorrect; the relevant angle is 22.9 deg. Any geometry lever must target 22.9 deg, not 54.7 deg.

premise_corrections.premise: No orientation exceeds ~1.5x, so the ~1.3-1.4x gain is a robust ceiling for field-free PP vdW gates
premise_corrections.corrected: In the two-channel C6 model, orientations near the total-C6 zero at 22.9 deg DO exceed 1.6x (1.73x at theta_gate=30, 1.96x at theta_gate=26, divergent as theta_gate->22.9 deg). But this is a MODEL BREAKDOWN: (a) the C6 zero at 22.9 deg is an unverified interpolation (E1 anchored only theta=0,90); (b) near the zero the higher-order C8 interaction dominates so the physical interaction does NOT vanish; (c) these orientations are weak-blockade gates (C6(26 deg)=4.7 vs C6(90 deg)=268 GHz*um^6, 57x weaker).
premise_corrections.consequence: The ~1.4x ceiling is robust for physical strong-blockade gates (theta_gate=90 deg), but the C6 model itself admits unphysical divergent gains near its zero. Downstream experiments must add a strong-blockade / higher-order constraint before quoting any >1.4x figure.

limitations: The dM=0-magic-angle hypothesis (54.7 deg) is a channel/total confusion: the total C6 there is +120 GHz*um^6, not zero.

The genuine total-C6 zero at 22.9 deg is a MODEL interpolation (E1 anchored only theta=0,90); its exact location and the smallness of C6 near it are unverified. Near the zero the vdW leading term vanishes and higher-order (C8) terms dominate, so the physical interaction does NOT vanish there.
The >1.6x gains are model UPPER BOUNDS, not physical packing wins: they require a weak-blockade gate orientation (C6 up to 57x weaker than theta=90 deg) and exploit the model zero.

Optimizer heuristic (scan + bounded Brent for L1, scan + bisection for L2) shows non-smooth landscape (1.73x vs 1.96x at nearby points); the quoted max is the best found, not a certified global optimum.
Lattice-family definition differs slightly from E2 (stagger offset fixed at half-period along the gate axis vs E2's free offset along the row axis), giving ~1.3% density spread at baseline.
No independent math sub-agent (backend unavailable); analytic derivation done by the orchestrator and verified numerically by the reviewed tool.
